lines.text: Job says his grief outweighs the sand of the seas, and the Almighty's arrows have pierced him.
Job says his brothers are faithless like wadis that vanish in the dry season, while caravans of Ur and Sheba look for water.
Job says he never asked his friends for a bribe, and he asks them to teach him how he has erred.
Job says he has been allotted months of futility, tosses and turns until dawn, and his days end without hope.
Job asks God if he is the sea that must be kept under guard, and says God has made him His messenger.

wrong_details.wrong: God has made him His messenger
